tldr: Sun through the 12th house brings focus to rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat.
body: Sun transiting the 12th house illuminates rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports private healing and release: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or escape, isolation, or avoiding what needs care.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 12th house deliberately. Work with rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
